text:
marta: Heads-up noticed a small but reproducible mismatch between the streaming aggregator and the invoice ledger for a set of tenants in NA-west. preview and final totals differ by ~0.6% repeatedly.

ken: which pipeline? streaming-agg -> final-ledger or the preview path?

marta: both. streaming-agg emits hourly aggregates to preview, final ledger replays raw events and does its own aggregation during finalization. They used to match within noise, now there's a persistent delta.

sylvia: any pattern? same tenants, same routes, or random?

marta: looks correlated to tenants using deterministic tenant-bucketing (weirdly) and to sessions with many small messages (high-churn chat). sample snippet: session s_zz, preview_sum=1042 tokens, final_sum=1036 tokens, diff=6.

metering-bot: scan result: 74 sessions in NA-west with preview>final by 0.4%..0.9% in last hour.

alan: suspicious: did we change any rounding/float handling in the aggregator? there was a micro-optim to use float32 in the streaming agg for perf a week ago.

ken: yep we flipped streaming-agg float32 optimization in release r1.14.0. finalizer still uses int64 token tallies and deterministic addition order. float accumulation error could explain small drift.

sylvia: so preview uses float32 sums -> occasional up/down jitter. finalizer uses integer arithmetic -> no jitter. customers might see preview differences but billing unaffected.

marta: CS flagged two customers asking why preview is higher. need quick mitigation.

ken: short-term: revert the float32 path in streaming-agg for tenant-bucketed streams (cheap config toggle). mid-term: canonicalize accumulation to a deterministic integer path or use compensated summation (Kahan).

alan: agree. also add a preview confidence tag when accumulators are float-based so UI can show lower confidence.

metering-bot: deploy metadata: r1.14.0 float32-accel enabled for regions: na-west, eu-central at 4100000000.

sre-bot: rolling config flip: streaming-agg.use_float32=false for na-west partitions 2..6 -> canary.

marta: canary up. initial re-check: preview vs final delta dropped from 0.6% -> 0.05% for the sampled tenants.

ken: good. I'll open a PR to implement int64 accumulators with Kahan fallback for high-cardinality streams. link PR: https://git.internal/streams/PR-489 (will add tests).

sylvia: UX side: I'll add a tiny banner on invoice-preview: "Preview uses approximate aggregation for some high-throughput streams; small deltas may occur. Final invoices authoritative." and a tooltip linking to docs.

marta: CS note draft: "Preview may show small overcounts for high-churn sessions due to streaming approximation optimizations. Final invoices are accurate. If you'd like a reconciliation for specific preview ids, share the ids and we'll run a ledger compare."

alan: action items: 1) ken revert float32 for tenant-bucketed streams (done canary) 2) ken PR for deterministic int accumulators + tests 3) sylvia UI banner + docs 4) marta CS blurb + runbook update.

metering-bot: ticket created: BILL-ACC-9921 'streaming agg float32 drift -> preview delta' assigned to ken/marta/sylvia.

marta: canary stable 25m, promoting config region-wide. leaving UI banner for 24h. closing unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:

ken: thanks, will follow up with PR details.

alan: add postmortem note to the r1.14 rollout docs. small but good catch.

sre-bot: config flip promoted. monitoring: preview_vs_final.delta.na-west < 0.1% for 40m.

marta: thanks all.
